finding: Fold 1 shows a different pattern from fold 0. Both plain_mhsa and edge_att beat base consistently across both seeds (paired diffs same sign), unlike fold 0 where plain_mhsa ~= base. But edge_att is consistently slightly below plain_mhsa in both seeds, suggesting attention capacity (not the edge prior specifically) may be what helps in fold1, if anything.
caveats: n=2 seeds per variant. Fold-to-fold comparison (fold0 vs fold1) is descriptive only, not a formal pooled test; folds use disjoint held-out data so their point estimates are not directly poolable without the observation-cluster bootstrap machinery used elsewhere in this project.
